newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian students in anti-Israeli protests.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian students in anti-Israeli protests.

text.p: Thousands of Egyptian students chanting anti-Israeli and anti-American slogans demonstrated in Cairo on Monday in protest at Israeli policies in Jerusalem.

The biggest protests were at Ain Shams University, where some 5,000 students marched from the faculty of law. Smaller demonstrations took place at the Azhar Islamic university and Helwan University in the southern suburbs, they said.

At Ain Shams, in northeastern Cairo, students set fire to Israeli and U.S. flags. Riot police watched from outside but did not intervene because the students did not try to leave the campus and spread out into the streets.

The demonstrations were the latest of several on Cairo campuses this month in protest at the Israeli government's decision to build more houses for Jews in East Jerusalem. The United States has upset them by vetoing two U.N. Security Council resolutions on the Israeli housing scheme.
